notes.title: Some news about the game
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First of all, I apologize for the silence here. I'm a solo developer and sometimes struggle to provide updates on all platforms. I'm much more active on the game's Twitter (X) account, but I'll do my best to share news here as well.

So about the game :  yes, it's still in development! :)

I work on the game in my free time, so it takes a while, but progress is being made. I also need to secure funding for graphics, music, voice overs, translations, etc...

However, there have been some recent developments:

Funding
I managed to secure a small amount of funding for the first chapter of the game (there are three chapters in total, and the game will be released as a single unit, not episodically).

Wishlist
The game has reached a total of 2,700 wishlists. The goal is to reach 7,500 to increase the chances of better visibility on Steam at launch. Any help you can provide to boost the game's visibility and, consequently, the number of wishlists is greatly appreciated :)

Thank you for your patience and support. I'll be back with more updates soon.

Best regards,
Nicolas
